latest.title: A topological version of the Cartan-Hadamard Theorem and asphericity complexity
latest.abstract: We investigate a topological version of the Cartan-Hadamard theorem that allows one to study asphericity of spaces via distinguished families of paths. A topological space has the distinguished path property (dpp) if there exists a continuous map from the space $Π(X)$ of homotopy classes of paths (relative endpoints) to the path space $X^I$ that is a right inverse to the canonical quotient map. For complete metric spaces endowed with a locally convex metric, the distinguished paths are precisely the local geodesics. We show that if $X$ has the dpp, then its universal cover is contractible and, in particular, $X$ is aspherical. The space $Π(X)$ is a fiber bundle over $X$ whose fiber is the universal cover of $X$, and in the case of Riemannian manifolds of non-positive curvature it is naturally isomorphic to the tangent bundle. We prove that every aspherical CW-complex that is locally finite or countable has the dpp, and this allows us to reinterpret asphericity of CW-complexes in terms of the existence of continuous sections. We also define and study the notion of asphericity complexity of spaces by means of local sections from $Π(X)$ to $X^I$ and relate it to the concept of equivariant topological complexity introduced by Colman and Grant.

latest.workSummary: 以同伦路径类的连续代表选择刻画一类空间的非球面性，并引入由局部截面定义的非球面复杂度。
latest.breakthrough: 将 Cartan–Hadamard 型结论转为拓扑路径选择问题，并在可数或局部有限 CW 复形上给出逆向刻画。
latest.limitations: 一般空间需要路径选择性质和相应拓扑条件；并非所有空间上无条件的曲率替代定理。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。 研究结论仅作摘要级分析，未独立核验证明。
latest.priorityReason: 把非正曲率思想转译到拓扑，工具可迁移，但当天主要用途偏基础拓扑。
